verdict.rationale: Serverless or edge deployment of server-rendered apps is a fair question for a UI framework and its ecosystem, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers SSR, serverless adapters, edge runtimes, or deployment presets. The docs items are generic homepage taglines and navigation links (Router, Pinia, Tooling), and the community comments are about reactivity, TypeScript and build tooling, so there is no evidence of this capability.
